text: Android: default-currency change should reflect in an already-open list

Done. Added DefaultCurrencyState (Singleton, in-memory StateFlow<String?> mirror of SessionState.defaultCurrency), written through by AuthRepositoryImpl.login() and SettingsViewModel.updateCurrency(). ListViewModel now collects it live instead of reading SessionState once at construction, so an already-open list picks up a Settings currency change immediately. Full suite + lint both clean, zero failures. Commit 7210c2b.
